info.title: G7VRD Satellite Passes
info.description: Pass predictions for the International Space Station over a coordinate pair, propagated from current TLEs. Free, keyless, and self-declared ALPHA — treat a failure as an outage, never as 'no passes'. Latitude and longitude are PATH segments, not query parameters.

get.summary: Upcoming ISS passes over a coordinate pair
get.description: Returns `{passes: [...]}`, each pass carrying `start`, `tca` (time of closest approach), `end`, `aos_azimuth` and `los_azimuth` (compass bearings where it rises and sets, degrees) and `max_elevation` (degrees above the horizon at culmination). 25544 is the ISS NORAD catalogue number.

parameters.name: min_elevation
parameters.description: Minimum culmination elevation in degrees. Default 30 — a pass lower than that is not worth going outside for.

200.description: Pass predictions; `passes` may legitimately be empty.
